problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing campaigns
Educate employees on recognizing social engineering tactics
Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Enforce strict email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Establish verification procedures for financial transactions
Monitor email accounts for anomalous login behavior

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob) leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement automated cloud configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies and encryption at rest
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers compromise software vendors or update mechanisms to distribute malicious code to downstream customers.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and supply chain risk assessments
Monitor vendor security posture and patch management rigorously
Use code signing and integrity verification for software updates

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate executives or trusted individuals to deceive employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Deploy deepfake detection tools and verification processes
Train staff to verify unusual requests via multiple channels
Implement strict transaction authorization policies

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade AI system performance or cause misclassifications.
risk_reduction: Use robust training data validation and anomaly detection
Employ adversarial training and model monitoring
Isolate and secure ML pipelines and data sources

problems.description: Malware that operates in memory without writing files to disk, evading traditional antivirus detection.
risk_reduction: Deploy endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions with behavior analytics
Implement application whitelisting and privilege restrictions
Monitor for anomalous process and network activity
